title: MSFS Just Added Live Satellite-Tracked Firefighting! (Marketplace Update)
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace just added a highly varied trio of content, taking us from corporate flight lines in the US over to unique international hubs in South East Asia—and even a brand new environmental utility tool. Whether you're managing a fleet of business jets or looking to completely change your emergency operations, this week's drop has an environment tailored to your operations.

In this marketplace breakdown, we are looking at everything from the regional charm of Jacksonville Executive to a beautifully detailed cultural destination with Luang Prabang International. Plus, we'll be checking out FS Fire, a brand new immersion pack designed to completely change how you handle emergency and rescue flights in the sim. Let's break those down to see which of these updates deserves a spot in your virtual hangar.

To make sense of this drop, we have organized the latest releases into two logical categories:

✈️ GLOBAL AIRSIDE GATEWAYS: We kick off in Florida with Jacksonville Executive Airport at Craig (KCRG) by Spinoza. This public airport is ideally situated near the beaches and downtown business district, featuring dual FBO layouts, detailed static support personnel, and excellent night lighting. It is fully compatible with both MSFS 2020 and MSFS 2024 (just ensure your US and Oceania World Updates are installed!). Next, we head to the heart of northern Laos to explore Luang Prabang International Airport (VLLB). Tucked into a narrow valley along the winding Mekong River, this jewel offers incredibly scenic yet demanding terrain-awareness approaches, beautifully modeled regional surroundings, and custom terminal interiors.

🔥 ENVIRONMENTAL IMMERSION UTILITIES: Finally, we dive into FS Fire by SoFly. This unique utility pulls real-time, live satellite data from the NOAA-20 satellite at 370-meter resolution to track and generate active fires globally every 30 minutes. Compatible with any aircraft, it features 325 missions, multiplayer support, and an interactive control panel to coordinate your water drops with automated ground troops.

Are you upgrading your emergency response fleet with FS Fire, or are you exploring the challenging mountain valleys of Laos? Let me know in the comments below which add-on is landing in your simulator first!

If this marketplace breakdown helps you save money and find the best add-ons, make sure to hit that like button and subscribe for weekly MSFS realism updates!
